release_notes: **Strategies with a Weekday filter only schedule their entry on that weekday.** The daily entry job used to fire every trading day and then skip itself; it now follows the spec's Weekday filter, and saving a strategy in the Composer reschedules it straight away. **No more broker polling or alerts from the position check when nothing is open.** The every-5-minutes orphan-position check now runs only while a real-mode strategy has an open trade, and only against the brokers those trades are on. Previously it polled every broker in use all day, so an expired Breeze or Dhan login sent a "reconciliation check failed" alert every 10 minutes even with no positions. The Reconcile badge still checks every broker on demand.
